note: Curated descriptive names for the decompiled flat DOS/4G image (stage 07). Addresses are image-relative (flat image imported at base 0). These are OUR analysis conclusions: each entry is added as its meaning is established from reading decompiled.c, and the docs/ notes carry the evidence. g_mode_flag gates init in main and toggles behavior across many subsystems; exact semantics TBD. The RNG names (rng_*), the asteroid-gen chain (asteroid_*) and the main-loop ticks are documented in docs/mechanics/rng.md, docs/mechanics/asteroid-creation.md, docs/mechanics/asteroid-spawning.md and docs/mechanics/main-loop.md. The game itself names these objects asteroids (the universe's colonizable worlds, each with its own surface); earlier drafts called them galaxies, which the game never does. asteroid_create makes a new asteroid node (rolls size class, surface width and seed); asteroid_place finds a free sector-grid slot and sets the node position; asteroid_gen_start_values rolls the 10 per-planet starting values into +0x6c; asteroid_setup_start_values copies them from a same-type asteroid, a static table, or an RNG perturbation; asteroid_rank_start_values scores the ten values against the per-slot divisor table and stores the best index at +0x53; obj_list_pop removes and returns the head node of an intrusive list. The main-loop expansion: g_game_state (0x34720) is the per-tick state dispatcher in main (0=init-scan, 1=object ticks, 2=colony economy, 3=structure update, 5=daily drift, 6=terrain generation passes, 7=world tick, 8=relations/fleet/event ticks, 0xf=end-game); the *_tick functions and g_* globals below were named from main's call graph and cross-checked in the recovered bodies. Names marked (TBD) in docs/mechanics/main-loop.md are plausible-but-unconfirmed roles; the token names are still useful for reading. Entries in the 0xcbxx per-type slot tables are stride-0x208 arrays indexed by type 0..14. Full-coverage pass: every recovered function in the GOG flat is now named (functions, globals, literals, strings; 3156 curated entries). The 0x6xxxx-0x7xxxx cluster is the statically-linked runtime (heap, DOS/4G/DPMI, VGA/SVGA, MIDI/SFX, printf/float-emulation, libc) and carries d4g_/dos_/gfx_/sfx_/libc_/math_/fmt_ prefixes; the 0x00000-0x4xxxx cluster is the game logic (ui_/gfx_/menu_/race_/colony_/fleet_/weapon_/obj_/structure_/terrain_/event_/relations_/ai_/save_). Ghidra thunk labels (thunk_FUN_*) are left as-is. Names for gap code (unrecovered functions such as the home-asteroid block) are not covered by this map because the tokens never appear in the export. The locals section renames function-scoped register/stack names (iVar3, sVar1, in_EAX, ...); entries are added only where the meaning is confirmed by disassembly and documented in docs/.
address_space: Addresses are for the flat image as imported (base 0). Two builds are known: the reference ISO build (see docs; addresses up to 0x6ffff) and the GOG retail build (addresses in 0x7xxxx-0xfffff range and the 0x1c7xx/0x166xx/0x6f8xx globals). Both sets are kept in this file; only the entries matching the imported image apply.
